description:
Establish compatible LDPC decoder benchmark arms. Establish reproducible operation-equivalent external baselines without changing production kernels.

## Background

The existing comparison runner covers DVB-T2 normal rate-1/2 and an NR BG1 mother-code configuration. AFF3CT is the established comparator; srsRAN and xdsopl are additional surveyed candidates, while OpenAirInterface build and adapter feasibility require verification. No project is presumed fastest on this host.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Publish pinned AFF3CT matched f32 flooding/NMS and supported f32 SIMD arms using identical recorded matrices/LLRs, normalization, iteration cap and stopping. Pin full command lines, precision, syndrome depth, inter-frame batch count, build flags and actual compiled/selected backend.

- [hard] REQ-03: Survey supported AFF3CT layered, fixed-point and INTRA/INTER combinations; pin and measure admissible fastest quality-compatible candidates instead of assuming the nominal widest mode wins. Account for batch fill, conversion, iteration distributions, memory, latency and BER/FER confidence intervals.

- [hard] REQ-04: Inspect and pin srsRAN for NR and xdsopl for DVB cells; verify OpenAirInterface source, licenses, buildability and accelerated backend. Record source-backed capability/compatibility findings and unavailable arms. Check current maintained upstreams or successors during pinning rather than assuming a named repository remains current.

- [hard] REQ-05: Provide validated adapters or an explicit not-expressible result for puncturing, fillers, mother-code versus rate-matched input, CRC/syndrome termination and output order. Quality-compatible differences remain labeled; do not force an unmatched stopping contract into the matched-algorithm table.

- [hard] REQ-06: Commit baseline measurements and adapter correctness evidence for the compatible shortlist under frozen family addenda. Exclude closed-source decoders from open-source arms; source access failures and rejected candidates remain visible.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.

Source references: [Cassagne2019], [Srsran2026], [Xdsopl2026], [OpenAirInterface2026].
